questions.question: A feature distribution changes, but no outcomes have arrived yet. What can the team conclude?
options: The model must be retrained immediately
P(Y|X) definitely changed
An input shift occurred, but model harm and concept drift are not yet established
The alert is necessarily a data-quality defect
questions.explanation: Unlabeled feature movement is evidence about P(X). Labels or other outcome evidence are needed to establish harm or changed P(Y|X).

questions.question: Why can an endpoint returning successful responses still be an unhealthy ML product?
options: Successful responses prove only that labels have arrived
Data, model quality, or cohort harm can regress while serving remains available
HTTP status automatically measures calibration
A deployed model cannot change its input distribution
questions.explanation: Serving health is one plane. Data validity, model behavior, and product outcomes can fail independently.

questions.question: What does the stability-plasticity trade-off describe?
options: Balancing new learning with preservation of earlier capabilities
Balancing CPU usage with disk capacity
Choosing between labels and features
Selecting one monitoring dashboard
questions.explanation: Plasticity enables adaptation to new data, while stability prevents the update from erasing useful prior behavior.

questions.question: What usually happens when the auto-decision confidence threshold is lowered?
options: More cases are automated, but more model errors may bypass review
Expert capacity increases automatically
Reviewer agreement becomes perfect
The training dataset becomes representative
questions.explanation: A lower threshold sends more cases directly to automation. That reduces review load but increases the chance that a wrong prediction escapes human review.

questions.question: A model artifact is 40 MiB. What does that prove about peak runtime memory?
options: Peak memory is exactly 40 MiB
Peak memory is always four times larger
Nothing by itself; weights, tensors, delegates, copies, and the host app must be measured
The model will fit any phone with more than 40 MiB of free storage
questions.explanation: Storage size and peak working memory are different quantities. Profile the integrated application on the target cohort.
